Program Overview
Program Details
Find your footing as a natural scientist with a master’s or doctoral degree in Biology from PSU. In our cutting-edge labs, you will conduct research, learn grantsmanship, gain teaching experience, and pursue an academically rigorous program that will allow you to succeed beyond graduate school.
Admissions Requirements
Meet PSU's minimum requirements
Contacted and interviewed with at least one but preferably three potential tenure-track faculty advisors.
Deadlines
September 1: Applications open
December 15: Priority consideration
Dec 16 - Jan 31: Rolling consideration
Feb 1: Applications close
This program only admits students once a year for fall term. Please note that our application fee policies have changed. An application fee of $67 is required from all applicants. If you have any questions, please contact gradschool@pdx.edu.
Application Materials
Below is the list of the materials and information you will need to provide as part of your application. We recommend preparing these materials in advance of submitting your application.
Potential Advisor: Graduate students in our program work closely with their faculty advisor. As you prepare your application, it is critical to contact a faculty member with whom you wish to work. Set up interviews (virtual or in-person) with prospective advisors to discuss common interests and research you would do as a graduate student.
Statement of Intent: In this we require you to describe: your reasons for applying to the graduate programs in the Biology department at PSU, who you want to work with, why you want to work with them, and whether you have contacted them.
References: Submit contact information for at least two references. Portland State will contact your references and provide them with instructions for submitting recommendation forms.
GRE (optional): The graduate programs in the Biology department at PSU do not currently require the GRE.
Copies of transcripts only from schools where a bachelor’s degree was awarded and/or graduate-level coursework was completed.
Proof of English Language Proficiency (if applicable)
